 Order

This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 20.03.2009 in Sessions Trial No. 214/08 by the First Additional Session Judge Mhow, Indore whereby appellant/accused - Bheru Singh has been convicted under Section 376 and 323 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I, 6 months R.I and fine of Rs.3,000/-, Rs 500/- respectively with default stipulation.

entities.text: First Additional Session Judge Mhow, Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 18.02.2008 in which accused has committed rape with the prosecutrix and regarding which a Crime No.78/2008 was registered at Police Station Simrol, Indore.

3. The PUD No.1435/Warrant/2024 dated 24.08.2024 of Superintendent, Sub Jail, Dr. Ambedkar Nagar, Mhow mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 04.05.2016 after completing the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21236 2 CRA-762-2009 sentence and depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
